title: Machine Learning for Dynamic Incentive Problems
title_zh: 机器学习在动态激励问题中的应用
title_primary: 机器学习在动态激励问题中的应用
title_secondary: Machine Learning for Dynamic Incentive Problems
authors: Philipp Renner and Simon Scheidegger
official: 官方在线 2026-09-11 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We present a flexible and scalable computational framework integrating machine learning and optimization theory to solve dynamic adverse selection models with persistent private information and many types. Our approach reformulates the model into a numerically tractable structure that bypasses set-valued dynamic programming; we formally prove that, under verifiable conditions, this relaxation yields the solution to the original problem.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一个灵活且可扩展的计算框架，将机器学习与优化理论相结合，以求解具有持续私人信息和多种类型的动态逆向选择模型。我们的方法将模型重构为一种数值上可处理的结构，从而绕开集值动态规划；我们正式证明，在可验证条件下，这种松弛可得到原问题的解。

title: DP11172 Mirrlees meets Diamond-Mirrlees
title_zh: 米尔利斯与戴蒙德-米尔利斯相遇
title_primary: 米尔利斯与戴蒙德-米尔利斯相遇
title_secondary: DP11172 Mirrlees meets Diamond-Mirrlees
authors: Florian Scheuer, Iván Werning
official: 官方在线 2016-03-16 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We show that the Diamond and Mirrlees (1971) linear tax model contains the Mirrlees (1971) nonlinear tax model as a special case. In this sense, the Mirrlees model is an application of Diamond-Mirrlees. We also derive the optimal tax formula in Mirrlees from the Diamond-Mirrlees formula. In the Mirrlees model, the relevant compensated cross-price elasticities are zero, providing a situation where an inverse elasticity rule holds. We provide four extensions that illustrate the power and ease of our approach, based on Diamond-Mirrlees, to study nonlinear taxation. First, we consider annual taxation in a lifecycle context. Second, we include human capital investments. Third, we incorporate more general forms of heterogeneity into the basic Mirrlees model. Fourth, we consider an extensive margin labor force participation decision, alongside the intensive margin choice. In all these cases, the relevant optimality condition is easily obtained as an application of the general Diamond-Mirrlees tax formula.
abstract_zh: 我们表明，Diamond和Mirrlees（1971）的线性税收模型将Mirrlees（1971）的非线性税收模型作为一个特例包含在内。在这个意义上，Mirrlees模型是Diamond-Mirrlees模型的一个应用。我们还从Diamond-Mirrlees公式推导出了Mirrlees模型中的最优税收公式。在Mirrlees模型中，相关的补偿交叉价格弹性为零，从而提供了一种逆弹性规则成立的情形。我们提供了四个扩展，展示了我们基于Diamond-Mirrlees研究非线性税收的方法的强大与简便。第一，我们在生命周期背景下考虑年度税收。第二，我们纳入人力资本投资。第三，我们将更一般形式的异质性纳入基本Mirrlees模型。第四，我们在集约边际选择之外，考虑广延边际的劳动参与决策。在所有这些情形中，相关的最优性条件都可以作为一般Diamond-Mirrlees税收公式的应用而轻松获得。

title: Locked Out: Drivers and Economic Implications of Declining Housing Affordability in Europe
title_zh: 被拒之门外：欧洲住房可负担性下降的驱动因素与经济影响
title_primary: 被拒之门外：欧洲住房可负担性下降的驱动因素与经济影响
title_secondary: Locked Out: Drivers and Economic Implications of Declining Housing Affordability in Europe
authors: Robert C. M. Beyer & Nina Biljanovska & Alexandra Fotiou & Morgan Maneely & Mr. Frederik G Toscani
official: 官方在线 2026-08-28 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Amid sharp house price increases in some parts of Europe, housing affordability has again become one of the main concern of households. This paper conducts three complementary sets of analyses to shed light on the drivers and economic implications of declining housing affordability. First, using a structural VAR, we show that supply-side factors have become increasingly prominent drivers of house prices—a notable shift from the credit-driven price increases that preceded the Global Financial Crisis. Second, drawing on household-level EU-SILC data, we argue that the burden has fallen disproportionately on lower-income urban renters, who face both rising rents and diminishing prospects of transitioning to homeownership. This is especially true for financially more vulnerable renters who have seen their probability of becoming home owners fall by more than half since the pre-GFC period. Third, we provide new empirical evidence that the resulting widening of income and wealth gaps between owners and renters is compounded by the efficiency cost of reduced labor mobility, as high housing costs make it harder for workers to move to more productive locations – quantitively, housing affordability constraints might have led to around one million foregone moves within the EU over the past decade. The analyses underpin the policy recommendations to alleviate housing affordability challenges set out in the IMF’s 2026 Euro Area consultation, including the need to focus on national measures to boost housing supply, with a complementary role for EU-level action.
abstract_zh: 在欧洲部分地区房价急剧上涨的背景下，住房可负担性再次成为家庭关注的核心问题之一。本文通过三组互补的分析，旨在揭示住房可负担性下降的驱动因素及其经济影响。首先，运用结构向量自回归模型，我们表明供给侧因素日益成为房价的主要驱动力——这一变化与全球金融危机前信贷驱动的房价上涨形成鲜明对比。其次，基于家庭层面的欧盟收入与生活条件统计数据，我们认为负担不成比例地落在了低收入城市租房者身上，他们既面临租金上涨，又面临成为房主前景的缩减。对于财务上更为脆弱的租房者而言尤为如此，自全球金融危机前以来，他们成为房主的概率已下降超过一半。第三，我们提供了新的实证证据，表明业主与租户之间收入及财富差距的扩大，因劳动力流动性降低带来的效率成本而进一步加剧，因为高昂的住房成本使得工人更难迁移至生产力更高的地区——从数量上看，过去十年间，住房可负担性约束可能导致欧盟内部约一百万次潜在迁移未能实现。上述分析为国际货币基金组织2026年欧元区磋商中提出的缓解住房可负担性挑战的政策建议提供了支撑，包括需重点采取国家层面措施以增加住房供给，同时欧盟层面的行动发挥补充作用。

title: Violence, Political Selection, and State Formation: Evidence from Post-Unification Italy
title_zh: 暴力、政治选拔与国家形成：来自意大利统一后的证据
title_primary: 暴力、政治选拔与国家形成：来自意大利统一后的证据
title_secondary: Violence, Political Selection, and State Formation: Evidence from Post-Unification Italy
authors: Paolo Buonanno, Giampaolo Lecce, Laura Ogliari, Giacomo Plevani
official: 官方在线 2026-04-28 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study how violence reshapes electoral competition and political selection during state formation. Using new district-level data on brigandage, elections, and political elites in post-unification Southern Italy, we show that violence reduced turnout, especially where it increased the risks of accessing polling stations. Beyond participation, brigandage also altered the supply side of politics: exposed districts experienced fewer contested elections and fewer new candidates. At the same time, political representation shifted away from aristocratic deputies and toward more locally embedded elites with administrative experience, while candidate pools also moved away from court-linked elite profiles. We provide evidence that these shifts were also reflected in parliamentary activity, with locally embedded representatives placing relatively greater emphasis on territorially targeted claims. Consistent with this pattern, districts more exposed to violence experienced greater expansion of the road network, but not railways, precisely where conflict induced a stronger shift toward local representation. These findings point to a political-representation channel through which violence shapes development, by altering who competes for office and how public resources are allocated.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了在国家形成过程中，暴力如何重塑选举竞争与政治精英选拔。利用意大利统一后南部地区关于匪患、选举及政治精英的新区级数据，我们表明暴力降低了投票率，尤其是在增加前往投票站风险的地方。除参与度外，匪患还改变了政治供给面：受暴力影响的地区经历了更少的竞争性选举和更少的新候选人出现。同时，政治代表构成从贵族议员转向更具地方根基且拥有行政经验的精英，而候选人群体也远离了与宫廷关联的精英类型。我们提供的证据显示，这些转变同样反映在议会活动中，地方根基深厚的代表相对更侧重于针对特定地域的诉求。与此模式一致，受暴力影响更大的地区在道路网络扩展上更为显著，但铁路并非如此，且恰恰是在冲突促使代表结构向地方倾斜更强烈的地区。这些发现揭示了一个政治代表渠道，暴力通过改变谁参与竞选以及公共资源如何分配，从而影响发展进程。

title: ICT, Collaboration, and Innovation: Evidence from BITNET
title_zh: 信息通信技术、协作与创新：来自BITNET的证据
title_primary: 信息通信技术、协作与创新：来自BITNET的证据
title_secondary: ICT, Collaboration, and Innovation: Evidence from BITNET
authors: Kathrin Wernsdorf, Markus Nagler, Martin Watzinger
official: 官方在线 2022-04-04 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Does access to technologies that reduce information and communication costs increase innovation? We examine this question by exploiting the staggered adoption of BITNET across U.S. universities in the 1980s. BITNET, an early version of the Internet, enabled e-mail-based knowledge exchange and collaboration among academics. After the adoption of BITNET, university-connected inventors increase patenting substantially. The effects are driven by collaborative patents by new inventor teams. The patents induced by ICT are closely related to science. In contrast, we neither find an effect on patents not closely related to science nor on corporate inventors unconnected to universities.
abstract_zh: 获取能降低信息与通信成本的技术是否会促进创新？我们通过利用20世纪80年代BITNET在美国各大学的逐步采用来探讨这一问题。BITNET作为互联网的早期版本，促进了学者间的电子邮件知识交流与合作。采用BITNET后，与大学关联的发明者专利申请显著增加。这一效应主要由新发明者团队的协作专利驱动。信息通信技术所激发的专利与科学紧密相关。相反，我们未发现对与科学关联不紧密的专利或与大学无关联的企业发明者产生影响。

title: DP11018 Shocking language: Understanding the macroeconomic effects of central bank communication
title_zh: 震惊的语言：理解中央银行沟通的宏观经济效应
title_primary: 震惊的语言：理解中央银行沟通的宏观经济效应
title_secondary: DP11018 Shocking language: Understanding the macroeconomic effects of central bank communication
authors: Stephen Hansen, Michael McMahon
official: 官方在线 2015-12-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We explore how the multi-dimensional aspects of information released by the FOMC has effects on both market and real economic variables. Using tools from computational linguistics, we measure the information released by the FOMC on the state of economic conditions, as well as the guidance the FOMC provides about future monetary policy decisions. Employing these measures within a FAVAR framework, we find that shocks to forward guidance are more important than the FOMC communication of current economic conditions in terms of their effects on market and real variables. Nonetheless, neither communication has particularly strong effects on real economic variables.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）发布的信息的多维方面如何影响市场变量和实际经济变量。利用计算语言学工具，我们衡量了FOMC关于经济状况的信息发布，以及FOMC对未来货币政策决策提供的指引。在FAVAR框架内采用这些度量，我们发现，前瞻指引的冲击对市场变量和实际变量的影响比FOMC对当前经济状况的沟通更为重要。尽管如此，这两种沟通对实际经济变量的影响均不特别显著。

title: 共建“一带一路”的粮食安全效应
title_zh: 共建“一带一路”的粮食安全效应
title_primary: 共建“一带一路”的粮食安全效应

abstract: 共建“一带一路”已成为深化国际合作、推动共同发展的重要平台与载体,科学评估其对参与国关键民生领域的潜在影响具有重大现实意义。本文从粮食安全视角出发,运用多时点双重差分模型进行深入分析。结果发现,共建“一带一路”显著改善了参与国粮食安全状况,并且这种影响主要表现在粮食可得性和可及性两个维度。机制分析表明,一方面,共建“一带一路”能够增强参与国农业生产能力,并扩大粮食进口贸易,从而形成自产与外购相结合...

title: Fiscal Reform in Spanish Municipalities: Gender Differences in Budgetary Adjustment
title_zh: 西班牙市政财政改革：预算调整中的性别差异
title_primary: 西班牙市政财政改革：预算调整中的性别差异
title_secondary: Fiscal Reform in Spanish Municipalities: Gender Differences in Budgetary Adjustment
authors: Israel García, Bernd Hayo
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Do gender differences matter for politicians' budgetary behaviour when confronted with institutional change? Following Spain's 2013 municipal reform, municipalities with more than 20,000 inhabitants lost responsibility for social services provision. Using a difference-in-differences design on municipalities in the Madrid region from 2010 to 2019, we find no effect of female representation on social services spending in the absence of the reform. Once the reform is taken into account, however, social services spending falls significantly in treated municipalities, and the decline is smaller where the share of female politicians is higher: governments with a female share of about 30% cut spending by an amount equivalent to more than 50% of average social services spending, whereas those with a 45% female share reduce spending by less than 20%. These findings suggest that female politicians are more likely to protect social services spending at the municipal level as responsibilities shift to the regional level.
abstract_zh: 性别差异在面临制度变革时是否会影响政治家的预算行为？以西班牙2013年市政改革为背景，超过两万居民的市镇失去了社会服务供给的职责。通过对马德里地区2010至2019年间市镇数据的双重差分分析，我们发现，在改革未实施的情况下，女性代表比例对社会服务支出并无影响。然而，一旦考虑改革因素，受改革影响的市镇社会服务支出显著下降，且女性政治家比例越高，支出减少幅度越小：女性占比约30%的政府削减的支出相当于平均社会服务支出的50%以上，而女性占比45%的政府削减幅度则不足20%。这些发现表明，随着职责向地区层面转移，女性政治家更倾向于在市镇层面保护社会服务支出。

title: Political Capture and Bureaucratic Behavior. Evidence from Mafia-Infiltrated Municipalities
title_zh: 政治俘获与官僚行为：来自黑手党渗透市镇的证据
title_primary: 政治俘获与官僚行为：来自黑手党渗透市镇的证据
title_secondary: Political Capture and Bureaucratic Behavior. Evidence from Mafia-Infiltrated Municipalities
authors: Maria Carreri, Davide Cipullo, Marco Le Moglie, Alberto Perego
official: 官方在线 2026-08-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Local governments promise democratic responsiveness but are also vulnerable to political capture by illicit actors. While existing research documents the political and economic consequences of capture, less is known about how bureaucrats respond when political leadership is captured - whether they become instruments of corrupt rule or resist it. We examine these competing expectations in the context of Italian municipalities infiltrated by mafia organizations. Leveraging a law that allows the central government to dissolve captured municipal councils, we study how bureaucratic performance responds when political capture is abruptly removed. Using a difference-in-differences design with matched controls based on a machine-learning index of mafia-infiltration risk, we show that dissolutions substantially improve bureaucratic performance. Evidence from administrative data and investigative reports supports the interpretation that the lower performance during mafia rule was driven by bureaucrats resisting political capture. Our findings show that bureaucracies mitigate, rather than amplify, the downstream consequences of political capture.
abstract_zh: 地方政府承诺民主回应性，但也易受非法行为者的政治俘获。尽管现有研究记录了俘获的政治与经济后果，但对于政治领导层被俘获时官僚如何应对——他们是沦为腐败统治的工具，还是予以抵制——知之甚少。我们在意大利被黑手党组织渗透的市镇背景下考察了这些相互竞争的预期。利用一项允许中央政府解散被俘获市议会的法律，我们研究了当政治俘获被突然移除时官僚绩效如何响应。基于黑手党渗透风险的机器学习指数匹配对照组，采用双重差分设计，我们表明解散显著改善了官僚绩效。来自行政数据和调查报告的证据支持这样一种解释，即黑手党统治期间较低的绩效是由官僚抵制政治俘获所驱动的。我们的发现表明，官僚机构缓解而非放大了政治俘获的下游后果。

title: The Economic Dynamics of City Structure: Evidence from Hiroshima's Recovery
title_zh: 城市结构的经济动态：来自广岛重建的证据
title_primary: 城市结构的经济动态：来自广岛重建的证据
title_secondary: The Economic Dynamics of City Structure: Evidence from Hiroshima's Recovery
authors: Kohei Takeda, Atsushi Yamagishi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-31 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines the resilience of city structure to a large shock and its underlying economic mechanisms. We analyze the atomic bombing of Hiroshima, which was an exogenous shock that leveled the city center but not its periphery, by combining newly digitized data with a dynamic quantitative urban model. We first construct spatially granular data within Hiroshima and document the resilience: the city center recovered just about five years after being destroyed. Importantly, we also show that the recovery of the city center is not necessarily explained by its fundamental locational characteristics. We then develop a novel dynamic urban economics model that allows us to disentangle the mechanisms underlying the recovery. Our calibrated model finds that strong agglomeration forces, together with individuals’ expectations of the recovery, created a strong incentive to rebuild the city center quickly despite the catastrophic shock.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了城市结构在面对重大冲击时的韧性及其背后的经济机制。我们以广岛原子弹爆炸为例，这一外生冲击夷平了城市中心但未波及周边区域，通过结合新数字化数据与动态定量城市模型进行分析。我们首先构建了广岛内部空间粒度数据，并记录了其韧性表现：城市中心在被摧毁后仅约五年便得以恢复。重要的是，我们还表明，城市中心的恢复并不必然由其基础区位特征所解释。随后，我们开发了一个新颖的动态城市经济学模型，以厘清恢复背后的机制。校准模型发现，强大的集聚力量，加之个体对恢复的预期，共同构成了在灾难性冲击后迅速重建城市中心的强烈激励。

title: DP5 Health: Historical Issues
title_zh: DP5 健康：历史问题
title_primary: DP5 健康：历史问题
title_secondary: DP5 Health: Historical Issues
authors: Charles Webster
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Assessments of the changing pattern of health in the present century are made on the basis of very limited evidence. Problems in evaluating such evidence as age specific mortality rates are considered. Fuller exploitation of morbidity records is advocated. But this data is notoriously difficult to interpret. The examples of malnutrition, tuberculosis and cancer are discussed to illustrate the degree to which a variety of factors lead to under-reporting. It is concluded that morbidity data is strongly influenced by revailing assumptions about health care; these in turn reflect economic pressures. Critical assessment of morbidity data casts doubt on the appropriateness and efficiency of health and welfare services, especially during the interwar period. These findings add to our difficulties in reaching firm conclusions about the impact on health of the Depression.
abstract_zh: 对20世纪健康状况变化模式的评估，是基于极为有限的证据进行的。本文探讨了在评估诸如特定年龄死亡率等证据时存在的问题，并主张更充分地利用发病率记录。然而，这类数据历来难以解读。本文以营养不良、结核病和癌症为例，说明多种因素如何导致漏报现象。结论指出，发病率数据深受主流医疗保健观念的影响，而这些观念又反映了经济压力。对发病率数据的批判性评估，使人们对健康与福利服务的适当性和效率产生质疑，尤其是在两次世界大战之间的时期。这些发现进一步增加了我们就大萧条对健康影响得出确切结论的难度。

title: Is Hybrid Work the Best of Both Worlds? Evidence from a Field Experiment
title_zh: 混合办公模式是否两全其美？来自田野实验的证据

authors: Prithwiraj Choudhury, Christos A. Makridis, Tarun Khanna, Kyle Schirmann
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper reports causal evidence on how the extent of hybrid work—the number of days worked from home relative to days worked from office—affects employee attitudes and performance. Workers who spent around two days in the office each week on average self-reported greater work-life balance, more job satisfaction, and lower isolation from colleagues compared to workers who spent more or fewer days in the office. Employees in the intermediate hybrid condition received no different performance ratings compared to peers who spent more or fewer days in the office.
abstract_zh: 本文报告了关于混合办公程度（即居家办公天数与办公室办公天数的比例）如何影响员工态度与绩效的因果证据。与每周在办公室工作天数更多或更少的员工相比，平均每周在办公室工作约两天的员工自我报告的工作与生活平衡度更高、工作满意度更高，且与同事的隔离感更低。处于中等混合办公条件下的员工，其绩效评级与每周在办公室工作天数更多或更少的同事相比并无显著差异。

title: AI, productivity, and work: Evidence from US firms
title_zh: 人工智能、生产率与工作：来自美国企业的证据
title_primary: 人工智能、生产率与工作：来自美国企业的证据
title_secondary: AI, productivity, and work: Evidence from US firms
official: 官方在线 2026-06-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Real-time evidence from users can inform the current policy debates around artificial intelligence. This column reports on a survey of executives at typical US firms to reveal that AI adoption is already widespread but shallow. Executives report positive productivity effects and expect larger gains, especially in high-skill services and finance, although measured gains lag perceived productivity improvements. The gains appear to come mainly through innovation- and demand-oriented channels rather than through cost cutting. Capital deepening is low, with most AI adopters renting intangible capital from upstream providers, and near-term employment effects are small on net, with larger reductions concentrated among larger firms and a shift away from routine clerical work towards skilled technical roles.
abstract_zh: 来自用户的实时证据可为当前围绕人工智能的政策辩论提供参考。本专栏报告了一项针对美国典型企业高管的调查，揭示人工智能的采用已广泛但尚浅。高管们报告了积极的生产率效应，并预期将获得更大收益，尤其是在高技能服务业和金融领域，尽管实际测量到的收益落后于感知到的生产率提升。这些收益似乎主要通过创新和需求导向渠道实现，而非通过成本削减。资本深化程度较低，大多数人工智能采用者从上游供应商处租用无形资本，且短期内的净就业影响较小，较大规模的裁员集中在大型企业，同时就业结构正从常规文书工作向技能型技术岗位转变。

title: The impact of international conflict on cross-border commercial dispute resolution
title_zh: 国际冲突对跨境商事争议解决的影响
title_primary: 国际冲突对跨境商事争议解决的影响
title_secondary: The impact of international conflict on cross-border commercial dispute resolution
authors: Dmitrii Shchetinin, Stanislav Avdeev
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: International trade depends on the expectation that courts will protect commercial interests when disputes arise. With the growing number of international conflicts, it is crucial to know whether this expectation is met in practice. We examine the effect of the 2014 annexation of Crimea on the enforcement rate of foreign decisions by Russian and Ukrainian judges. We assemble novel data on the entire universe of Russian and Ukrainian court decisions concerning the enforcement of foreign decisions resolving cross-border commercial disputes. Using a difference-in-differences design, we find that the enforcement rate of Ukrainian (Russian) decisions in Russia (Ukraine) fell by 26% (33%) after the annexation. We show that courts increasingly justified refusals through discretionary legal grounds and undue-notification claims. Our findings provide the first causal evidence that international conflict affects both judicial decision-making and compliance with commercial treaties.
abstract_zh: 国际贸易依赖于一种预期，即当纠纷发生时，法院会保护商业利益。随着国际冲突日益增多，了解这一预期在实践中是否得到满足至关重要。我们研究了2014年克里米亚被吞并事件对俄罗斯和乌克兰法官执行外国判决率的影响。我们收集了关于俄罗斯和乌克兰法院处理跨境商业纠纷中外国判决执行问题的全部判决的新数据。采用双重差分法，我们发现吞并事件后，乌克兰（俄罗斯）判决在俄罗斯（乌克兰）的执行率下降了26%（33%）。研究表明，法院越来越多地通过自由裁量的法律理由和不当通知主张来拒绝执行。我们的研究首次提供了因果证据，证明国际冲突会影响司法决策以及商业条约的遵守情况。

title: Is Growth Additive?
title_zh: 增长是可加的吗？
title_primary: 增长是可加的吗？
title_secondary: Is Growth Additive?
authors: Callum J. Jones, David López-Salido, Thomas Philippon
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Growth theory is based on the assumption of exponential total factor productivity (TFP) growth, or that the conditional expectation of the next TFP increment is proportional to the current level of TFP. In the U.S., we find strong evidence that TFP growth is conditionally additive, not exponential. Even starting from low priors, Bayesian estimation selects the additive model over the exponential one. In addition, professional forecasts and international TFP series are consistent with the additive model but not with the exponential one.
abstract_zh: 增长理论建立在全要素生产率（TFP）呈指数增长或下一期TFP增量的条件期望与当前TFP水平成比例的假设之上。在美国，我们发现了强有力的证据表明TFP增长是条件可加的，而非指数形式。即使从较低的先验概率出发，贝叶斯估计也倾向于选择可加模型而非指数模型。此外，专业预测数据与国际TFP序列均与可加模型一致，而与指数模型不符。

title: Inflation concerns and green product consumption: Evidence from a nationwide survey and a framed field experiment
title_zh: 通胀担忧与绿色产品消费：基于全国性调查和框架田野实验的证据
title_primary: 通胀担忧与绿色产品消费：基于全国性调查和框架田野实验的证据
title_secondary: Inflation concerns and green product consumption: Evidence from a nationwide survey and a framed field experiment
authors: Sabrina Jeworrek, Lena Tonzer
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Promoting green (usually more costly) product consumption is one essential element in building a sustainable society. In times of high inflation, not only budget constraints but also the fear that prices will continue to rise might limit the effectiveness of exerted efforts to promote sustainable behaviors. To test this suggestion, we conducted a Germany-wide survey with almost 1200 respondents, followed by a framed field experiment to confirm causality. Our proxy for green consumption is organic food purchases. Survey respondents’ stated organic purchasing behavior is positively correlated with concerns about climate change but negatively correlated with concerns about inflation. The latter result is driven by individuals with a below-median environmental attitude. In the framed field experiment, we use the priming method to manipulate the saliency of inflation concerns. Whereas sizably relaxing the budget constraint has no impact on the share of organic products in participants’ baskets, the priming significantly decreases the share of organic products for individuals with below-median environmental attitude. Using the same inflation priming in a subsequent survey experiment with around 1800 respondents, we find that high inflationary environments affect both the perception of organic being luxury products and the social norm of buying organic. Both effects are more pronounced for individuals with below-median environmental attitude and, hence, they are the likely mechanisms driving the negative effects on organic product consumption.
abstract_zh: 推广绿色（通常成本更高）产品消费是构建可持续社会的基本要素之一。在高通胀时期，不仅预算约束，而且对价格持续上涨的担忧，都可能限制促进可持续行为所付出努力的有效性。为验证这一观点，我们在德国开展了一项覆盖近1200名受访者的全国性调查，并随后进行了一项框架性实地实验以确认因果关系。我们以有机食品购买作为绿色消费的代理指标。调查受访者所报告的有机购买行为与对气候变化的担忧呈正相关，但与对通胀的担忧呈负相关。后者结果主要由环境态度低于中位数的个体驱动。在框架性实地实验中，我们采用启动方法操纵通胀担忧的显著性。尽管大幅放宽预算约束对参与者购物篮中有机产品的比例没有影响，但启动显著降低了环境态度低于中位数个体中有机产品的比例。在随后一项涉及约1800名受访者的调查实验中，使用相同的通胀启动，我们发现高通胀环境既影响有机产品被视为奢侈品的认知，也影响购买有机产品的社会规范。这两种效应在环境态度低于中位数的个体中更为显著，因此，它们可能是驱动有机产品消费负面效应的潜在机制。

title: Expecting Floods: Firm Entry, Employment, and Aggregate Implications
title_zh: 预期洪水：企业进入、就业与总体影响
title_primary: 预期洪水：企业进入、就业与总体影响
title_secondary: Expecting Floods: Firm Entry, Employment, and Aggregate Implications
authors: Ruixue Jia, Xiao Ma, Victoria Wenxin Xie
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Using county-level and zip-code-level data from the United States during the period 1998–2018, we document: (i) Increased flood risk has a large negative impact on firm entry, employment, and output in the long run; (ii) Flood events reduce output in the short run while impact on firm entry and employment is limited. We then develop a quantitative spatial model to characterize how flood risk shapes firms’ location choices and employment. We find flood risk reduced US aggregate output by 0.53 percent in 2018, 23 percent of which stemmed from direct damages and 77 percent from long-run adjustments of firms and workers. (JEL D22, E23, E24, L11, Q54, R23, R32)
abstract_zh: 利用1998–2018年间美国县级和邮政编码级数据，我们得出以下发现：（i）长期来看，洪水风险的增加对企业进入、就业和产出产生显著的负面影响；（ii）短期来看，洪水事件会降低产出，但对企业进入和就业的影响有限。随后，我们构建了一个定量空间模型，用以刻画洪水风险如何影响企业的区位选择和就业。研究发现，2018年洪水风险使美国总产出下降了0.53%，其中23%源于直接损失，77%源于企业与工人的长期调整。（JEL分类号：D22, E23, E24, L11, Q54, R23, R32）

title: Comment on ‘Fisher–Schultz Lecture: Contracting Over Pharmaceutical Formularies and Rebates’ by Kate Ho and Robin Lee
title_zh: 对凯特·何与罗宾·李《费舍尔-舒尔茨讲座：药品目录与返利合同》的评论
title_primary: 对凯特·何与罗宾·李《费舍尔-舒尔茨讲座：药品目录与返利合同》的评论
title_secondary: Comment on ‘Fisher–Schultz Lecture: Contracting Over Pharmaceutical Formularies and Rebates’ by Kate Ho and Robin Lee
authors: Rena M. Conti
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Biopharmaceuticals advance health and economic growth. Unlike central bargaining abroad, the United States uses private firms, pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs), to manage medicine access and spending. Yet, PBMs' roles in advancing efficiency are understudied. Ho and Lee model PBMs' use of tiered formularies, lists of covered medicines, without the use of proprietary data on the price concessions drug makers offer for preferred placement. They find PBMs' use of tiered formularies generate significant payor savings through competition. Complementing Ho and Lee, Feng and Maini (2024) model how patient demand inertia limits PBMs' ability to extract price concessions from drug makers which consequently erodes the efficacy gains of PBM formularies. Conti, Frandsen, Powell, and Rebitzer (2021) model formulary auctions where PBM size drives payor savings, but also spurs endogenously set high list prices, reducing patient access. Future economic research should focus on PBM market entry and vertical integration, pharmacy steering, and effects on innovation.
abstract_zh: 生物制药推动健康与经济增长。与国外集中谈判不同，美国依靠私营企业——药品福利管理者（PBMs）来管理药品获取与支出。然而，关于PBMs在提升效率方面的作用研究尚不充分。Ho和Lee构建了PBMs使用分级处方集（即承保药品清单）的模型，而未利用药企为获得优先地位而提供的价格优惠专有数据。他们发现，PBMs通过分级处方集的使用，借助竞争机制为支付方带来了显著的成本节省。作为对Ho和Lee研究的补充，Feng和Maini（2024）建模分析了患者需求惯性如何限制PBMs从药企获取价格优惠的能力，进而削弱了PBM处方集的效率收益。Conti、Frandsen、Powell和Rebitzer（2021）则对处方集拍卖进行了建模，指出PBM规模虽能驱动支付方节省成本，但也促使药企内生地设定高昂标价，从而降低了患者的药品可及性。未来经济研究应聚焦于PBM市场进入与纵向整合、药房引导行为及其对创新的影响。

title: The Disability Employment Paradox? Reconciling trends in disability, health and employment in the UK, 2014-2022
title_zh: 残疾就业悖论？英国2014-2022年残疾、健康与就业趋势的调和
title_primary: 残疾就业悖论？英国2014-2022年残疾、健康与就业趋势的调和
title_secondary: The Disability Employment Paradox? Reconciling trends in disability, health and employment in the UK, 2014-2022
authors: Mark Bryan, Andrew Bryce, Jennifer Roberts, Cristina Sechel
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The last decade has seen a significant worsening of health in the UK, driven by an increase in mental health conditions, with a consequent increase in the number of disabled people. At the same time overall employment growth has been strong and the employment rate of disabled people has grown faster than that of non-disabled people. How can we reconcile this apparent paradox of declining health and growing employment? Using detailed observational data for 2014-2022 from a large survey of the UK population we employ counterfactual analysis to explore this puzzle. We present three key findings. First, the rise in the employment rate of disabled people and the narrowing of the disability employment gap (DEG) cannot be attributed to changes in the health of the disabled population. Second, the narrowing of the DEG is predominantly associated with a parallel reduction in the education attainment gap between disabled and non-disabled people. Finally, despite increased employment among disabled people, the growing size of the disabled population has reduced the growth of the overall employment rate. Our work has a number of implications for policy targeted at improving the employment outcomes of disabled people. While the DEG has narrowed, disability prevalence has increased, leading to lower employment rates than would otherwise have prevailed. Hence, there is still a crucial role for the health care sector in improving labour market outcomes and thus overall welfare levels in the UK. Moreover, the interdependence of health and employment status requires joined up health care and labour market policy making.
abstract_zh: 过去十年间，英国健康状况显著恶化，主要源于心理健康问题的增加，导致残疾人口数量随之上升。与此同时，整体就业增长强劲，残疾人群体的就业率增速甚至超过非残疾人群体。如何解释这种健康水平下降与就业增长并存的明显悖论？我们利用2014-2022年英国大规模人口调查的详细观测数据，通过反事实分析探究这一谜题。研究得出三项关键发现：第一，残疾人就业率上升及残疾就业差距（DEG）缩小不能归因于残疾人口健康状况的变化；第二，DEG的缩小主要与残疾人与非残疾人之间教育程度差距的同步缩小相关；第三，尽管残疾人就业增加，但残疾人口规模的扩大反而拉低了整体就业率的增长。本研究对改善残疾人就业状况的政策制定具有多重启示：虽然DEG有所收窄，但残疾患病率的上升导致实际就业率低于原本可能达到的水平。因此，医疗保健部门在改善英国劳动力市场表现及整体福利水平方面仍具关键作用。此外，健康与就业状态的相互依存性要求医疗保健与劳动力市场政策制定必须协同推进。

title: Are the upwardly mobile more Left‐wing?
title_zh: 向上流动者更左倾吗？
title_primary: 向上流动者更左倾吗？
title_secondary: Are the upwardly mobile more Left‐wing?
authors: Andrew E. Clark, Maria Cotofan
official: 官方在线 2026-06-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: It is well‐known that the wealthier are less likely to have Left‐leaning political preferences. In addition, we consider here the role of the individual's starting position, and in particular their upward social mobility relative to their parents. In 18 waves of UK panel data, both own and parental social status are independently negatively associated with Left‐leaning voting and political preferences; given their own social status, the upwardly mobile are therefore more Left‐wing. We replicate these findings using US data, and show that in both countries, the choice of specification when controlling for the respondent's own current status is crucial and may explain some of the mixed findings on mobility and political preferences in the existing literature.
abstract_zh: 众所周知，财富水平较高者持有左翼政治偏好的可能性较低。此外，本文进一步考察了个体初始社会地位的作用，特别是其相对于父母的向上社会流动性。基于英国18轮面板数据，个人自身社会地位与父母社会地位均与左翼投票倾向及政治偏好呈独立负相关关系；在控制自身社会地位后，向上流动者反而表现出更强的左翼倾向。我们利用美国数据复现了上述发现，并表明在两国样本中，控制受访者当前自身社会地位时的模型设定选择至关重要，这或可解释现有文献中关于社会流动性与政治偏好关系的部分矛盾结论。

title: Acquisitions, Innovation and the Entrenchment of Monopoly
title_zh: 收购、创新与垄断地位的固化
title_primary: 收购、创新与垄断地位的固化
title_secondary: Acquisitions, Innovation and the Entrenchment of Monopoly
authors: Vincenzo Denicolò, Michele Polo
official: 官方在线 2026-05-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We analyze a dynamic model of repeated innovation where inventors may either be acquired by an incumbent or else resist takeover and challenge for leadership. In the short run, acquisitions always spur innovation because of the invention-for-buyout effect. In the longer run, however, they may stifle it because of a countervailing effect, the entrenchment of monopoly. The latter occurs when the incumbent's dominance depends on past levels of activity and is therefore reinforced by recurrent acquisitions. We show that if the entrenchment effect is sufficiently strong, forward-looking policymakers should prohibit acquisitions in anticipation of the long-run negative impact on innovation. This argument sets out a new theory of harm that can be used to block acquisitions that could otherwise go unchallenged.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了一个重复创新的动态模型，其中发明者可能被现有企业收购，或者抵制收购并挑战领导地位。短期内，收购总能通过“发明-购买”效应刺激创新。然而，从长远来看，由于一种抵消效应——垄断的固化，收购可能会抑制创新。当现有企业的支配地位依赖于过去的活跃水平，并因此被反复收购所强化时，就会出现这种固化效应。我们证明，如果固化效应足够强，前瞻性的政策制定者应预见收购对创新的长期负面影响而予以禁止。这一论点提出了一种新的损害理论，可用于阻止那些否则可能不受质疑的收购。

title: Rising waters, falling taxes: The impact of Hurricane Sandy on property tax assessments in New York City
title_zh: 涨水与减税：飓风桑迪对纽约市房产税评估的影响
title_primary: 涨水与减税：飓风桑迪对纽约市房产税评估的影响
title_secondary: Rising waters, falling taxes: The impact of Hurricane Sandy on property tax assessments in New York City
authors: Wei Guo, Qing Miao, Yusun Kim, Yilin Hou
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-02-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Climate disasters can inflict significant property damage and depress housing markets, yet their effects on property tax administration remain poorly understood. Homeowners with or without property damage may face tax burdens that do not match changes in their property values after disasters. This study examines the impact of Hurricane Sandy on property values and tax assessments in New York City. Using a difference-in-differences approach and comprehensive property-level data, we find that (1) inundated properties faced greater tax burdens due to taxable values falling less than corresponding market values after the storm; (2) unaffected properties in flood zones saw even larger tax burden increases as market values fell while taxable values remained unchanged; and (3) higher-valued homes bore larger tax burden hikes. These uneven consequences largely reflect the interplay between market reactions to Hurricane Sandy and City’s tax relief measures and existing assessment policies, highlighting how property tax administration is intertwined with disaster responses in the era of climate change.
abstract_zh: 气候灾害可能造成重大财产损失并抑制住房市场，然而其对房产税管理的影响仍鲜为人知。无论房屋是否受损，业主都可能面临与灾后房产价值变化不匹配的税负。本研究考察了飓风桑迪对纽约市房产价值及税收评估的影响。采用双重差分法并利用全面的房产层面数据，我们发现：（1）受灾淹没的房产因应税价值下降幅度小于灾后相应市场价值，而承担了更高的税负；（2）洪泛区内未受影响的房产，因市场价值下降而应税价值保持不变，其税负增幅更大；（3）价值较高的房屋承受了更大的税负增加。这些不均衡的后果主要反映了市场对飓风桑迪的反应与城市税收减免措施及现有评估政策之间的相互作用，凸显了在气候变化时代，房产税管理与灾害应对如何紧密交织。

title_secondary: Medicaid and teen suicide
authors: Dave E. Marcotte Alexandra Rakus a School of Public Affairs, American University, Washington, DC, USAb Institute for the Study of Labor (IZA), Bonn, Germany
official: 官方在线 2025-06-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examine whether increases in Medicaid coverage among teens reduced suicide risk. Youth are at elevated risk for depression but receive the least care. We exploit state-level variation in Medicaid coverage controlling for crowd-out to identify effects on risk for suicide. We build an age-group/state/year panel measuring suicide rates from CDC data and age-specific rates of insurance coverage from the American Community Survey from 2009 to 2021. We estimate that among those between the ages of 15 and 19, suicide rates fell by 0.023 log points or 1% of the mean with each 1% increase in the population of teens covered by Medicaid. This decline was larger for teens than any other group. We assess whether our TWFE estimated effect of a continuous treatment approximates an average causal response by comparing treatment effects at different margins. We form 47 treatment-control groupings of states changing key features of Medicaid enrolment policies in different years along with always/never treated states. Our treatment effects of Medicaid expansion at these various margins are within confidence bounds for our average effects. This article provides the first evidence on the role of public health insurance coverage on teen suicide in the U.S. KEYWORDS: Medicaid mental health Affordable Care Act suicide JEL CLASSIFICATION: I10 I12
abstract_zh: 本文考察了青少年医疗补助覆盖范围的扩大是否降低了自杀风险。青少年患抑郁症的风险较高，但获得的医疗服务最少。我们利用各州医疗补助覆盖范围的差异（控制挤出效应）来识别其对自杀风险的影响。我们构建了一个年龄组/州/年份的面板数据，使用2009年至2021年疾病控制与预防中心的自杀率数据以及美国社区调查的特定年龄保险覆盖率数据。估计结果显示，在15至19岁人群中，医疗补助覆盖的青少年人口每增加1%，自杀率下降0.023对数点，即平均水平的1%。这一降幅在青少年群体中显著大于其他任何年龄组。我们通过比较不同边际上的处理效应，评估了连续处理的TWFE估计效应是否近似于平均因果响应。我们根据各州在不同年份改变医疗补助注册政策关键特征的情况，以及始终/从未接受处理的州，形成了47个处理-控制分组。在这些不同边际上，医疗补助扩展的处理效应均在我们平均效应的置信区间内。本文首次提供了关于公共健康保险覆盖对美国青少年自杀影响的证据。关键词：医疗补助；心理健康；平价医疗法案；自杀 JEL分类：I10；I12
